mapper.sql: FROM knowledge_relation_recollection_evidence e LEFT JOIN review_recollection_version v ON v.owner_id=e.owner_id AND v.recollection_id=e.recollection_id AND v.id=e.version_id
mapper.select: SELECT r.owner_id,r.id,r.source_id,r.target_id,r.relation_type AS type, s.kind AS source_kind,s.status AS source_status,t.kind AS target_kind,t.status AS target_status FROM knowledge_relation r JOIN knowledge_item s ON s.owner_id=r.owner_id AND s.id=r.source_id JOIN knowledge_item t ON t.owner_id=r.owner_id AND t.id=r.target_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_recollection_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND relation_id=#{relationId})
SELECT owner_id,id,snapshot_json FROM knowledge_relation_recollection_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
